name: Replo
description:
Connect Claude to your Replo workspace and run ecommerce work from one conversation. Find projects, sites, products, assets, orders, and performance data. Build or update storefront experiences with Replo Agent, publish when you’re ready, manage products and assets, connect custom domains, and schedule recurring work.

Use it to launch a product page from catalog data, find the right campaign assets, inspect orders, diagnose an underperforming page, or turn analytics into an A/B test.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Replo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Replo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.replo.app/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Replo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replo lists 26 MCP tools, including abort_agent_session, connect_custom_domain, create_product, create_project, create_task, delete_task, find_assets, find_orders, find_products, get_agent_session, get_custom_domain_status, and get_order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Replo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Replo in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Replo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Replo is developed by Replo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
